steps.comment: ITEM 1: the stores book says what is on the crag by arithmetic, the crag has it, and Ott renders it down. Nothing anywhere says what it is.
The ledger stands on the drawing office bookshelf, which is solid: walking into it turns Bram to face it and the action button does the rest.

steps.label: the stores book: issued 199 times, returned 198
the crag is at the end of a track the works keeps cut
in through the rent, which is the only thing broken on her
one crate, stencilled on all six faces, and two of you carry it
ITEM 1 is off the crag for the first time since 1802
and what is left is four straps and a set of chocks

steps.comment: Her crate page is appended below both of her beat chains, so like the other two appended pages it requires switch 70 - the last switch the flying chain sets, and therefore the one that means she has nothing else owing. Without that guard, walking in with the crate before the ship was finished deleted the handover page and the airship with it.
steps.label: the crate does not talk over anything Ott still owes you
the crate in the party beats every other page Ott has
and takes the fuse out of it first, before anything else is touched
the rest comes back from Ollerenshaw's as eighteen pounds on a shaft

steps.comment: Asserted as a range rather than an index on purpose. What she falls back to depends on how far along she is, and this scenario got to her by setting self switch D directly instead of walking her introduction - so the honest answer here is her opening page, and pinning that number would be pinning the shortcut. What matters is the part that is about the crate: none of her three appended pages hold any more, because the crate is what was holding them.
steps.label: and with the crate gone none of her appended pages hold, so she goes back to whatever she was saying
